sql: SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips_2025 FROM trips_daily WHERE year(service_date) = 2025;
notes: Assumes "completed trips in 2025" means all provider types and boroughs summed from trips_daily by service_date year.

sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / SUM(total_pickups) AS pickup_otp_pct_2025 FROM pickup_otp_daily WHERE standard = '20-minutes' AND year(service_date) = 2025
notes: Assumes the default 20-minute standard (the official MTA standard), all provider types (Primary and Broker) and all boroughs, with 2025 defined as service_date in calendar year 2025.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE year(opened_date) = 2024
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2024
)
SELECT
  c.complaints,
  t.trips,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaint_rate_per_1000
FROM c, t
notes: Assumes calendar year 2024 for both complaints (by opened_date) and trips (by service_date), with complaints and trips aggregated separately before dividing, and all provider types and categories included.
